review.rationale: Initial release budgets replace the debug-only 120/180 second launch ceilings. Absolute limits are safety rails calibrated from local release observations and the first same-host GitHub runner release comparison, while the current-main comparison remains the primary 20 percent regression gate. Cross-VM phase gate: the compared reports are produced on separate runner VMs, so CPU model, core count, runner image, and WebView runtime are excluded from compatibility; absolute caps plus identical fixtures and sampling keep the comparison meaningful.

evidence.source: Issue #49: 2026-08-25 Linux WebKit measurements and implementation baseline runs
PR #58 run 32942547888: Linux AppImage baseline/candidate startup p95 was 31.40/31.47 seconds on the same hosted runner with at most 0.69 percent difference

PR #58 runs 32942547888, 32946504534, and 32950388617: identical bootstrap catalog hooks kept refresh p50 within 785.39-813.42 ms while first-browser p95 ranged from 873.86-1727.80 ms; cached-read p95 ranged from 3.17-59.56 ms

PR #58 runs 32946504534, 32950388617, and 32953791298: identical Windows bootstrap sources kept candidate warm-start p50 changes to 16.0, 1.9, and 8.6 percent; run 32953791298 failed p95 only because one 984.97 ms Tukey outlier exceeded the 765.82 ms baseline p95

PR #124 run 33912788179: an unrelated Marketplace launch-retry change produced a 2048.374 ms Windows cold-start p95 against a 1472.412 ms baseline (575.962 ms absolute difference) while the installed MSI and NSIS performance suites passed
Main runs 33919703993 and 33925549585: Linux release navigation p95 missed its relative gate by 3.441 ms and 21.326 ms respectively on unrelated test-only changes

backgroundPollingCpuPercent.rationale: Five-second normalized samples catch sustained polling without treating a single wakeup as idle load.

idleCpuPercent.rationale: The previous normalized idle observation was 4.41 percent over a much shorter window.

privateMemoryBytes.rationale: The observed 331 MB process tree leaves material but finite WebKit runner variance.

workingSetBytes.rationale: RSS is tracked independently because shared WebKit pages make it larger than private memory.

processCount.rationale: The complete release WebKit root and descendant tree is bounded and compared with main.

privateMemoryGrowthBytes.rationale: Five-minute positive private-memory growth above 64 MiB is treated as a leak signal.

workingSetGrowthBytes.rationale: Working-set growth receives extra shared-page headroom but remains bounded.

processCountGrowth.rationale: At most two transient descendants may remain at the final sample; larger growth fails.

coldStartupMs.rationale: Installed package launch must create its native window within a user-visible budget.

warmStartupMs.rationale: Repeated installed package launches exercise the warmed OS and WebView caches.

idleCpuPercent.rationale: Installed package idle CPU uses the same normalized process-tree meaning.

privateMemoryBytes.rationale: Installed package private memory uses the release WebView safety ceiling.

workingSetBytes.rationale: Installed package RSS is reported separately from private memory.

processCount.rationale: Installed package root and live descendants use the same bounded process-tree scope.

privateMemoryGrowthBytes.rationale: Installed package private-memory growth is bounded across the five-minute window.

workingSetGrowthBytes.rationale: Installed package working-set growth is tracked separately from private bytes.

processCountGrowth.rationale: Installed package child-process growth is checked across the full idle window.

backgroundPollingCpuPercent.rationale: Normalized five-second samples distinguish periodic work from sustained CPU.

idleCpuPercent.rationale: The five-minute window covers WebView2 and backend polling descendants.

privateMemoryBytes.rationale: WebView2 receives a 768 MiB safety ceiling while same-host main catches smaller changes.

workingSetBytes.rationale: Working set is distinct from private memory and includes shared WebView2 pages.

processCount.rationale: The Tauri and WebView2 descendant tree is counted on every sample.

privateMemoryGrowthBytes.rationale: Five-minute positive private-memory growth above 96 MiB is a leak signal.

workingSetGrowthBytes.rationale: WebView2 working-set growth is bounded separately from private bytes.

processCountGrowth.rationale: Long-idle child count may not accumulate beyond two transient processes.

coldStartupMs.rationale: Installed MSI and NSIS cold launches must create a native window within 20 seconds.

warmStartupMs.rationale: Warm installer launches isolate application startup from installation time.

idleCpuPercent.rationale: Installed WebView2 process-tree CPU uses five-minute normalized sampling.

privateMemoryBytes.rationale: MSI and NSIS package memory shares the release WebView2 safety ceiling.

workingSetBytes.rationale: Installed bundle RSS remains independently visible and bounded.

processCount.rationale: Installed Tauri and WebView2 root and descendants are counted at every sample.

privateMemoryGrowthBytes.rationale: Installed bundle private-memory growth is bounded across the five-minute window.

workingSetGrowthBytes.rationale: Installed bundle working-set growth is tracked separately from private bytes.
